hero.title: Websites with clear structure, premium design and transparent planning.
hero.description: Every project is individual. Our prices serve as transparent orientation — the final scope depends on goals, structure, design level and required functionality.

priceFactors.title: What influences the price?
priceFactors.description: The starting price gives a first orientation. The final scope depends on how large the website will be, which functions are needed and how individually the design should be developed.

items.title: Scope
items.description: A compact landing page is planned faster than a multi-page business website with many content sections.

items.title: Functions
items.description: Forms, multilingual content, bookings, shops or special areas increase the technical effort.

items.title: Design level
items.description: The more individual, premium and brand-specific the website should feel, the more intensive the design work becomes.

packages.title: Clear packages for different project sizes.
packages.description: Whether it is a compact landing page, a professional business website or a custom platform — every package provides a clear foundation and can be extended if needed.

items.idealFor: Ideal for freelancers, experts, single services or marketing campaigns.

items.name: Prestige

items.idealFor: Ideal for premium brands, growing companies and custom websites with a strong design focus.

items.name: Custom
items.shortDescription: For shops, platforms and individual digital solutions.
items.idealFor: Ideal for online shops, portals, platforms, booking systems or more complex web applications.

subscription.title: Start professionally — without a high upfront investment.
subscription.description: For businesses that want a high-quality website but prefer to plan the investment monthly. The website is professionally created, maintained and can be expanded later.
subscription.note: Minimum term: 24 months. Setup costs depend on the project scope.

redesign.title: When your current website no longer matches your standards.
redesign.description: Many businesses already have a website — but it looks outdated, unclear or not convincing enough. We analyze existing websites and turn them into modern, high-quality and user-friendly digital presences.

additionalServices.title: Flexible modules for special requirements.
additionalServices.description: Not every project needs the same services. Depending on your goals, additional modules may be useful.

items.question: Why are there no fixed final prices?
items.answer: Because every website has different goals, content and functions. The prices shown are orientation values. After a short conversation, you receive an individual offer.

items.question: Can I start small and expand later?
items.answer: Yes. Many projects start with a clear landing page or compact website and are expanded later.

items.question: Is SEO included?
items.answer: A technical and structural SEO foundation is included. Extended SEO strategy, SEO content and ongoing optimization can be booked additionally.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: A landing page usually takes 1–3 weeks. A business website usually takes 3–6 weeks. Complex projects are planned individually.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. Our care packages help keep your website maintained, current and ready for further development.

cta.title: Ready to start your project professionally?
cta.description: Tell us briefly about your project — we will check which website solution fits your goals, budget and brand.
cta.note: Free initial assessment. Transparent. Personal. Non-binding.
